_readme: Skills, tags, status effects and skill trees. Percentages are fractions (0.8 = 80%). Ranges are in tiles (Euclidean: 1 = the 4 neighbours, 1.5 includes diagonals). Cooldown N = can't be used during your next N turns. Keys starting with _ are comments. The game checks this file on load and reports the exact field if something is wrong.

_fields.target: unit (aim at a tile, affects the unit there) | self | line (8 directions) | cone (overwatch) | emptyTile
_fields.hits: list of hits, each { pAtk, mAtk, def, missingHp } as fractions
_fields.los: sight (rocks block) | fire (rocks AND units block). Omit for none.
_fields.rangeScale: for 'movement' skills: range = floor(rangeScale x Movement)
_fields.optional: heal { mAtk }, shield { maxHpPct, turns }, knockback (tiles), cleanse, teleport, charge, aoeRadius, lineLength, cone { angle, radius, interrupt, los }, accuracy

melee.name: Melee
melee.description: A close-range strike. No line of sight needed.

engage.name: Engage
engage.description: On hit, you and the target become engaged (unless the target is already engaged). Engaged units can't move or attack anyone else until they disengage, which gives the opponent a free basic attack. Engaged units have half Defense but take 50% less damage from their opponent.

projectile.name: Projectile
projectile.description: Needs a clear line to the target (line of sight, or line of fire for direct shots).

indirect.name: Indirect
indirect.description: Arcs over obstacles: no line of sight needed.

knockback.name: Knockback
knockback.description: Pushes targets away. Blocked by walls and other units.

reaction.name: Reaction
reaction.description: Sets up a watch that fires during the enemy's turn when they move into it.

movement.name: Movement
movement.description: Range scales with your Movement stat (rounded down), so Slow shortens it.

weapon.name: Weapon
weapon.description: Uses your equipped weapon's basic-attack range and line rules. Unusable while your weapon is disabled.

free.name: Free Action
free.description: Doesn't use your action: you can still act afterwards.

debuff.name: Debuff
debuff.description: Applies a harmful effect that Cleanse can remove.

burn.name: Burn
burn.description: Takes 1% max health per stack at the start of each of its turns. Ignores Defense and shields.

slash_and_smash.name: Slash and Smash
slash_and_smash.description: Sword for 80% P.Atk, then shield for 40% P.Atk + 100% Def.

shield_up.name: Shield Up
shield_up.description: Gain a shield worth 10% of max health until your next turn.

spear_thrust.name: Spear Thrust
spear_thrust.description: Thrust up to 2 tiles in a direction: 100% P.Atk to the first enemy hit, knocking it back 1 tile.

circle_swing.name: Circle Swing
circle_swing.description: Hit ALL units on the 8 surrounding tiles (allies too!) for 100% P.Atk and knock them back 1 tile.

intercept.name: Intercept
intercept.description: Watch a 60° cone (2 tiles). Strikes the first enemy that moves into it for 100% P.Atk and stops its movement.

direct_shot.name: Direct Shot
direct_shot.description: Shoot a unit for 100% P.Atk. Needs line of fire: rocks AND units in between block the shot.

indirect_shot.name: Indirect Shot
indirect_shot.description: Lob an arrow over obstacles for 70% P.Atk.

overwatch.name: Overwatch
overwatch.description: Watch a 90° cone (5 tiles). Shoots the first enemy that moves into it for 100% P.Atk without stopping it.

empowered_strike.name: Empowered Strike
empowered_strike.description: Strike a unit for 100% P.Atk + 50% M.Atk.

magic_bolt.name: Magic Bolt
magic_bolt.description: Bolt a unit for 50% P.Atk + 50% M.Atk.

arcane_pulse.name: Arcane Pulse
arcane_pulse.description: Blast a unit for 100% M.Atk and knock it back 2 tiles.

arcane_shift.name: Arcane Shift
arcane_shift.description: Teleport yourself to an empty tile within 50% of your Movement.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: 100% M.Atk and 1 stack of Burn for 2 turns.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.description: Freeze a unit for 100% M.Atk and Slow it (-1 Movement) for 2 turns.

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.description: Remove all debuffs (Burn, Slow...) from a unit.

charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Dash next to a unit within 100% of your Movement and strike for 80% P.Atk.

kick.name: Kick
kick.description: Kick for 60% P.Atk. Free: you can still act afterwards.

execute.name: Execute
execute.description: 50% P.Atk plus 10% of the target's missing health, at your weapon's range.
